events.description: Summer Sports Experience is an instructional youth program that teaches sports skills. Our knowledgeable NYC Parks staff train kids in sports such as basketball, ball hockey, kickball, flag football, pickleball, soccer, team handball, track and field, and volleyball. This program covers basic and more advanced techniques.  Summer Sports Experience is a drop-in program recommended for children ages 8-14. Participants can stop by for one or more sessions, but kids who stay for the whole program will get the most benefit from it. Occasionally a Summer Sports Experience program may be cancelled due to harsh weather or other conditions.Please note: We recommend that guardians accompany children participating in this program. Summer Sports Experience is not a childcare program, and NYC Parks is not responsible for the well-being of attendees. For more information, please visit nyc.gov/parks.  Contact accessibility@parks.nyc.gov or (212) 360-1430 for more information regarding accessibility.

events.title: Trees Count at Bennett Park
events.description: Volunteer with NYC Parks for Trees Count 2025! At each event you will receive a tote bag with all the materials needed to count trees. Returning volunteers are welcome, and will receive additional giveaway items such as shirts, books, and hip bags as supplies last. Next, we'll provide a 30-minute training session that includes the basics of tree identification and how to measure and assess each tree. Using our Tree Census app, you’ll split up into different zones within the park to start counting trees! After completing your first training event, you are welcome to continue counting trees on your own in smaller parks across the city. For your comfort and safety, please bring water and wear closed-toe shoes to this program.

events.title: Volunteer Day: Bay 84th Street Community Garden
events.description: GreenThumb community gardens are developed, led, and cared for by dedicated volunteer gardeners who critically upkeep them as public green spaces.Bay 84th Street Community Garden, is seeking volunteers and new garden members who are interested in helping preserve this vital green space. The garden is creating space for those who are curious and willing to dig in. Join us for a hands-on volunteer day to beautify the garden! Spend the day digging in alongside fellow community members as we tackle garden clean-up tasks such as weeding, spreading mulch, litter collection, and general garden maintenance. No prior experience necessary - beginners are welcome! GreenThumb will provide supplies and facilitation.This is a great opportunity to support and join a dynamic community space while learning about community gardens. Please wear comfortable, weather-appropriate clothing and bring water and snacks. Note: Some tasks may involve lifting heavy materials and extended periods of bending, squatting, and moving.Register here! Join our first event on August 1st here! Location: 3-22 Beach 84th St, Rockaway Beach, NY 11693For information about group volunteering, please contact Volunteer Program Coordinator, Olivia Navarro at Olivia.Navarro@parks.nyc.govThis event is co-hosted by NYC Parks GreenThumb. We are proud to be the nation’s largest urban community gardening program, sustaining over 550 gardens throughout New York City. With GreenThumb’s support, community gardens are centers of environmental justice, ensuring that our city is fairer, safer, and greener for all. GreenThumb’s events are free and open to the public.

events.title: Volunteering at Conference House Park - The Blue Wave
events.description: Join NYC Parks and the Conference House Park Conservancy for our ongoing beach and park clean-up initiative!Pick up a trash grabber and a bucket and help to beautify our park by picking up litter and debris!Stop by the park Visitor's Center at 298 Satterlee Street, corner of Hylan Boulevard, Staten Island, NY, to meet our staff and borrow a bucket and grabber!Drop-ins welcome. No RSVP required. Blue Wave clean-ups are self-led by the volunteer stewards themselves. For group volunteer opportunities and volunteering at additional Staten Island South Shore sites, please contact the South Shore Parks Programs and Events Manager at 646-406-2155, or carmine.raimondi@parks.nyc.gov.
events.location: Conference House Museum (in Conference House Park)

events.title: Walking Tour: The Tredwells’ World of 19th Century Noho
events.description: With the 1825 opening of the Erie Canal, the city’s economy boomed and wealthy merchant families escaped the increasing noise, congestion, and commercialization of the seaport area to move “uptown,” to what is now modern day NoHo, then an exclusive residential enclave. Join us as we explore the Tredwells’ elite neighborhood and discover what life was like for the wealthy merchant class in the mid-19th century.Walking tours are 90 minutes and meet next door to the Merchant’s House in Manuel Plaza.

events.title: Wheel Fun Rentals Celebrates America's 250th with Patriotic LED Bike Ride
events.description: Wheel Fun Rentals at Boathouse Row is lighting up summer nights in patriotic style as it celebrates America's 250th anniversary with special Red, White & Blue LED Illuminated Surrey Night Rides. Patriotic Surrey Nights Rides are available now and will run through Labor Day Weekend at their Bensonhurst Park and FDR Boardwalk at Sand Lane bike rental locations.For the summer-long celebration, Wheel Fun Rentals has transformed its popular LED-illuminated specialty bikes into dazzling patriotic attractions featuring custom red, white, and blue lighting. Families, couples, and friends can cruise along two of New York City's scenic waterfronts while celebrating America's historic 250th birthday.On July 4th, guests can make the holiday even more memorable by riding to waterfront viewing areas for spectacular fireworks displays. Launching from Bensonhurst Park in Brooklyn, riders can enjoy the festive atmosphere along the waterfront bike path with views across New York Harbor. On Staten Island, guests can pedal along the FDR Boardwalk, where the waterfront provides a scenic setting to take in the evening's Independence Day celebrations and fireworks over the harbor.Night Rides are first-come, first-served and available Friday – Sundays and holidays beginning at sunset until 10pm, last 1-hour rental goes out at 9pm. Pricing is $29 for a Single Surrey (seats up to 3 adults and 2 small children), and $39 for a Double Surrey (seats up to 6 adults and 2 small children).For additional location information, current hours of operation, and to learn more about Wheel Fun Rentals available recreational rental options, visit wheelfunrentals.com/NYC.
